'''Scepter Cay''' was a settlement on the planet [[Aquilaris Minor]] during the [[New Sith Wars]]. As of [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], the settlement was in the hands of the [[Daimanate]], one of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] fiefdoms in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]]. During an [[Battle of Capital Cay|assault]] on [[Capital Cay]] by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crimelord [[Zodoh]], an unidentified Daimanate commander attempted to leave in a food transport to get reinforcements from Scepter Cay. However, before he could do that, he was killed by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]], who had returned to her homeworld to fight against the Sith.
